G5147.def:
**τρίβος**, -ου, -ἡ
(τρίβω), [in LXX for מְסִלָּה, נָתִיב, etc. ;]
**a beaten track, a path**: [[Mat.3.3|Mat.3:3]], [[Mrk.1.3|Mrk.1:3]], [[Luk.3.4|Luk.3:4]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5101.def:
**τίς**, neut., τί, genitive, τίνος, _interrog. pron._, [in LXX for מָה ,מִי ;] in masc. and fem.,
**who, which, what?**; in neut., **which, what?**, used both in direct and in indirect questions.
I. I. As subst.,
1. 1. masc., fem.: τίς; **who, what?**, [[Mat.3.7; 26.68|Mat.3:7 26:68]]; [[Mrk.11.28|Mrk.11:28]], [[Luk.9.9|Luk.9:9]], al. mult.; with genitive partit., [[Act.7.52|Act.7:52]], [[Heb.1.5|Heb.1:5]], al; before ἐκ (= genitive partit.), [[Mat.6.27|Mat.6:27]], [[Luk.14.28|Luk.14:28]], [[Jhn.8.46|Jhn.8:46]]; = ποῖος, [[Mrk.4.41; 6.2|Mrk.4:41 6:2]], [[Luk.19.3|Luk.19:3]], [[Act.17.19|Act.17:19]], al.; = πότερος (M, _Pr._, 77), [[Mat.21.31; 27.17|Mat.21:31 27:17]], [[Luk.22.27|Luk.22:27]], al.; = ὅς or ὅστις (rare in cl.; cf. Bl., §50, 5; M, _Pr._, 93), [[Act.13.25|Act.13:25]]
2. Neut.: τί; **what?**, [[Mat.5.47; 11.7|Mat.5:47 11:7]], [[Mrk.10.3|Mrk.10:3]], al.; χάριν τίνος, [[1Jn.3.12|1Jn.3:12]] διὰ τί, [[Mat.9.11|Mat.9:11]], al.; εἰς τί, [[Mat.14.31|Mat.14:31]], al.; elliptically, ἵνα τί (sc. γένηται), **why**, [[Mat.9.5|Mat.9:5]], al.; τί οὖν, [[Rom.3.9; 6.1, 15|Rom.3:9 6:1, 15]] [[1Co.14.15|1Co.14:15]], al.; τί γάρ, [[Rom.3.3|Rom.3:3]], [[Php.1.18|Phi 1:18]]; τί ἐμοὶ (ὑμῖν) καὶ σοί, see: ἔγω.
II. As adj.: **who? what? which?**, [[Mat.5.46|Mat.5:46]], [[Luk.14.31|Luk.14:31]], [[Jhn.2.18|Jhn.2:18]], al.
III. As adv.: = διὰ τι (τί ὅτι), **why**, [[Mat.6.28|Mat.6:28]], [[Mrk.4.40|Mrk.4:40]], [[Luk.6.46|Luk.6:46]], [[Jhn.18.23|Jhn.18:23]], al.; in rhet. questions, = a negation, [[Mat.27.4|Mat.27:4]], [[Jhn.21.22, 23|Jhn.21:22, 23]] [[1Co.5.12; 7.16|1Co.5:12 7:16]], al. in exclamations (like Heb. מָה), **how** ([[2Sa.6.20|2Ki.6:20]], [[Psa.3.2|Psa.3:2]], al.), [[Luk.12.49|Luk.12:49]].
(AS)

G5100.def:
**τις**, neut., τι, genitive, τινός,
_enclitic indefinite pron._, related to interrog. τίς as πού, πως, ποτέ to ποῦ, πῶς, πότε.
I. As subst.,
1. **one, a certain one**: [[Luk.9.49|Luk.9:49]], [[Jhn.11.1|Jhn.11:1]], [[Act.5.25|Act.5:25]], al.; pl., τίνες, **certain, some**: [[Luk.13.1|Luk.13:1]], [[Act.15.1|Act.15:1]], [[Rom.3.8|Rom.3:8]], al.
2. **someone, anyone, something, anything**: [[Mat.12.29|Mat.12:29]], [[Mrk.9.30|Mrk.9:30]], [[Luk.8.46|Luk.8:46]], [[Jhn.2.25|Jhn.2:25]], [[Act.17.25|Act.17:25]], [[Rom.5.7|Rom.5:7]], al.; = indef., **one** (French _on_), [[Mrk.8.4|Mrk.8:4]], [[Jhn.2.25|Jhn.2:25]], [[Rom.8.24|Rom.8:24]], al.; pl., τινες, **some**, [[Mrk.14.4|Mrk.14:4]], al.
II. II. As adj.,
1. **a certain**: [[Mat.18.12|Mat.18:12]], [[Luk.1.5; 8.27|Luk.1:5 8:27]], [[Act.3.2|Act.3:2]], al.; with proper names, [[Mrk.15.21|Mrk.15:21]], [[Luk.23.26|Luk.23:26]], al.; with genitive partit., [[Luk.7.19|Luk.7:19]], al.
2. **some**: Mrk.16:[8], [[Jhn.5.14|Jhn.5:14]], [[Act.17.21; 24.24|Act.17:21 24:24]], [[Heb.11.40|Heb.11:40]], al.
(AS)

G5142.def:
**τρέφω **
[in LXX for חָיָה hi., גָּדַל pi., אָכַל hi., etc. ;]
1. to make to grow, bring up, rear (cl.; [[1Ma.3.33|1Ma.3:33]] [[1Mac.11.39|1Mac 11:39]]): [[Luk.4.16|Luk.4:16]] (T, WH, mg., ἀνατ-)
2. **to nourish, feed**: [[Mat.6.26; 25.37|Mat.6:26 25:37]], [[Luk.12.24|Luk.12:24]], [[Act.12.20|Act.12:20]], [[Rev.12.6, 14|Rev.12:6, 14]]; of a mother, to give suck, [[Luk.23.29|Luk.23:29]] of animals, to fatten ([[Jer.26.21|Jer.26:21]] ([[Jer.46.21|Jer.46:21]]), figuratively, [[Jas.5.5|Jas.5:5]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐκ-, ἐν-τρέφω).†
(AS)

G5118.def:
**τοσοῦτος**, -αύτη, -οῦτο
([[Heb.7.22|Heb.7:22]]) and (elsewhere, as usually in Attic) -οῦτον, correlat. of ὅσος, of quantity, size, number, so great, so much, pl., **so many**: [[Mat.8.10|Mat.8:10]] [[Luk.7.9|Luk.7:9]], [[Heb.12.1|Heb.12:1]], [[Rev.18.7, 16|Rev.18:7, 16]]; of time, so long, χρόνος, [[Jhn.14.9|Jhn.14:9]], [[Heb.4.7|Heb.4:7]]; pl., [[Luk.15.29|Luk.15:29]] (ἔτη), [[Jhn.12.37; 21.11|Jhn.12:37 21:11]], [[1Co.14.10|1Co.14:10]]; before ὥστε, [[Mat.15.33|Mat.15:33]] absol.: pl., [[Jhn.6.9|Jhn.6:9]], [[Gal.3.4|Gal.3:4]]; of price, τοσούτου, [[Act.5.8|Act.5:8]] dative, τοσούτῳ κρείττων, [[Heb.1.4|Heb.1:4]] τ. μᾶλλον ὅσῳ, [[Heb.10.25|Heb.10:25]] καθ᾽ ὅσον . . . κατὰ τ., [[Heb.7.22|Heb.7:22]]†
(AS)

G5199.def:
**ὑγιής**, -ές, accusative, ὑγιῆ (Attic usually -ιᾶ),
[in LXX for חַי, etc. ;]
**sound, whole, healthy**: [[Mat.12.13; 15.31|Mat.12:13 15:31]], Jhn.5:[4], 6, 9, 11, 14, 15 7:23, [[Act.4.10|Act.4:10]]; before ἀπό, [[Mrk.5.34|Mrk.5:34]] of words, opinions, etc. (as in cl.), metaphorically, λόγος, [[Tit.2.8|Tit.2:8]]†
(AS)

G5188.def:
**τύφω**
(τῦφος, smoke),
**to raise a smoke**; pass., **to smoke**: [[Mat.12.20|Mat.12:20]] (LXX, καπνιζόμενον).†
(AS)

G5140.def:
**τρεῖς**, οἱ, αἱ, τρία, τά
**three**: [[Mat.12.40|Mat.12:40]], al.; μετὰ τ. ἡμέρας = τῇ τρίτῃ ἡ., [[Mrk.10.34|Mrk.10:34]], al. (cf. Field, _Notes_, 11 ff.)
Τρεῖς Ταβέρναι
(see: ταβέρνη),
Three Taverns (Lit. Tres Tabernae) a halting place on the Appian Way: [[Act.28.15|Act.28:15]] (see _DB_, iv, 690).†
(AS)

G5117.def:
**τόπος**, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for מָקוֹם ;]
**place**: [[Luk.4.37; 10.1, 32|Luk.4:37 10:1, 32]] [[Jhn.5.13; 6.10|Jhn.5:13 6:10]], [[Act.12.17|Act.12:17]], [[1Co.1.2|1Co.1:2]], al.; τ. ἅγιος (cf. [[Isa.60.13|Isa.60:13]]), [[Mat.24.15|Mat.24:15]]; ἔρημος, [[Mat.14.13|Mat.14:13]], al.; πεδινός, [[Luk.6.17|Luk.6:17]] ἄνυδρος (pl.), [[Mat.12.43|Mat.12:43]], [[Luk.11.24|Luk.11:24]]; κατὰ τόπος (BV, _in divers places_), [[Mat.24.7|Mat.24:7]], [[Mrk.13.8|Mrk.13:8]]; τραχεῖς τ., [[Act.27.29|Act.27:29]] τ. διθάλασσος (which see), ib. 41; ἑτοιμάζειν τ., [[Jhn.14.2|Jhn.14:2]], 3; ἔχειν, [[Rev.12.6|Rev.12:6]] διδόναι, [[Luk.14.9|Luk.14:9]] with genitive defin., τ. βασάνου, [[Luk.16.28|Luk.16:28]] τ. καταπαύσεως, [[Act.7.49|Act.7:49]] κρανίου, [[Mat.27.33|Mat.27:33]], [[Mrk.15.22|Mrk.15:22]], [[Jhn.19.17|Jhn.19:17]]; before οὗ, [[Rom.9.26|Rom.9:26]] ὅπου, [[Mat.28.6|Mat.28:6]], [[Mrk.16.6|Mrk.16:6]], [[Jhn.4.20; 6.23; 10.40; 11.30; 19.41|Jhn.4:20 6:23 10:40 11:30 19:41]]; ἐν ᾧ, [[Jhn.11.6|Jhn.11:6]] ἐφ ̓ ᾧ, [[Act.7.33|Act.7:33]] of a place which a person or thing occupies, [[Rev.2.5; 6.14; 12.8|Rev.2:5 6:14 12:8]]; τ. μαχαίρας, [[Mat.26.52|Mat.26:52]] ὁ ἴδιος τ., [[Act.1.25|Act.1:25]] of a place in a book, [[Luk.4.17|Luk.4:17]] (cf. Clem. Rom., _I Co._, 8, 4). Metaphorical, of condition, **station, occasion, opportunity or power**: [[Act.25.16|Act.25:16]], [[Rom.12.19; 15.23|Rom.12:19 15:23]], [[Eph.4.27|Eph.4:27]] (cf. [[Sir.38.12|Sir.38:12]]).
_SYN._: χώρα (extensive), _region_; χωρίον (enclosed), _a piece of ground_. τ. is "a portion of space viewed in reference to its occupancy, or as appropriated to a thing " (Grimm-Thayer, see word). (AS)

G5132.def:
**τράπεζα**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שֻׁלְחָן, also for לֶחֶם, etc. ;]
1. **a table, dining-table**: [[Mat.15.27|Mat.15:27]], [[Mrk.7.28|Mrk.7:28]], [[Luk.16.21; 19.23; 22.21, 30|Luk.16:21 19:23 22:21, 30]]; of the table of shewbread, [[Heb.9.2|Heb.9:2]] By meton., of food provided (see _DB_, iv, 670 a): [[Act.16.34|Act.16:34]], [[Rom.11.9|Rom.11:9]]" (LXX) [[1Co.10.21|1Co.10:21]] διακονεῖν ταῖς τ., [[Act.6.2|Act.6:2]] (cf. Page, in l, but see infr.).
2. **A money-changer's table, a bank **(Dem., Arist., al.): [[Mat.21.12|Mat.21:12]], [[Mrk.11.15|Mrk.11:15]], [[Luk.19.23|Luk.19:23]], [[Jhn.2.15|Jhn.2:15]]; so also accusative to Dr. Field (_Notes_, 113), [[Act.6.2|Act.6:2]] (but see supr.).†
(AS)

G5154.def:
**τρίτος**, -η, -ον
**the third**: [[Mat.22.26|Mat.22:26]], [[Mrk.12.21; 15.25|Mrk.12:21 15:25]], [[Luk.24.21|Luk.24:21]], [[Act.2.15|Act.2:15]], al.; τῇ τ. ἡμέρᾳ (i.e. the next day but one: Xen., al.; see Field, _Notes_, 11 ff.), [[Mat.16.21|Mat.16:21]], [[Luk.24.46|Luk.24:46]], al.; substantively, accusative masc., τρίτον, a third (servant), [[Luk.20.12|Luk.20:12]] neut., τὸ τ., with genitive, **the third part of**: [[Rev.8.7-12; 9.15, 18; 12.4|Rev.8:7-12 9:15, 18 12:4]]. As adv., τὸ τ., **the third time**: [[Mrk.14.41|Mrk.14:41]], [[Jhn.21.17|Jhn.21:17]]; anarth., τρίτον, a third time, [[Luk.23.22|Luk.23:22]], [[Jhn.21.14|Jhn.21:14]], [[2Co.12.14; 13.1|2Co.12:14 13:1]]; in enumerations, thirdly, [[1Co.12.28|1Co.12:28]] ἐκ τ., a third time, [[Mat.26.44|Mat.26:44]]
(AS)

G5137.def:
**τράχηλος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for צַוַּאר, also forעֹרֶף, etc. ;]
**the neck**: [[Mat.18.6|Mat.18:6]], [[Mrk.9.42|Mrk.9:42]], [[Luk.17.2|Luk.17:2]]; ἐπιπεσεῖν ἐπὶ τὸν τ., to embrace ([[Gen.46.29|Gen.46:29]]), [[Luk.15.20|Luk.15:20]], [[Act.20.37|Act.20:37]]. Metaphorical, ὑποθεῖναι τὸν ἑαυτοῦ τ. (for similar phrase in π., see Zorell, see word), [[Rom.16.4|Rom.16:4]] ἐπιθεῖναι ζυγὸν ἐπὶ τὸν τ., [[Act.15.10|Act.15:10]]†
(AS)

G5169.def:
**τρύπημα**, -τος, τό
(τρυπάω, to bore)
**a hole**: τ. ῥαφιδος, eye of a needle, [[Mat.19.24|Mat.19:24]] (WH, txt., τρῆμα).†
_SYN._: τρῆμα, τρυμαλιά (AS)

G5195.def:
**ὑβρίζω**
(ὕβρις), [in LXX for גֵּאֶה, etc. ;]
1. intrans., to wax wanton, run riot.
2. Trans., **to outrage, insult, treat insolently**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.22.6|Mat.22:6]], [[Luk.11.45; 18.32|Luk.11:45 18:32]], [[Act.14.5|Act.14:5]], [[1Th.2.2|1Th.2:2]].†
(AS)

G5111.def:
**τολμάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Job.15.12|Job.15:12]] (לָקַח), [[Est.1.18; 7.5|Est.1:18 7:5]] (לֵב מָלֵא) [[Jdt.14.13|Jdth.14:13]], [[2Ma.4.2|2Ma.4:2]], [[3Ma.3.21|3Ma.3:21]] R, [[4Ma.8.18|4Ma.8:18]] * ;]
**to have courage, to venture, dare, be bold**: absol, [[2Co.11.21|2Co.11:21]] before ἐπί, [[2Co.10.2|2Co.10:2]] with inf. (Bl., § 69, 4), [[Mat.22.46|Mat.22:46]], [[Mrk.12.34|Mrk.12:34]], [[Luk.20.40|Luk.20:40]], [[Jhn.21.12|Jhn.21:12]], [[Act.5.13; 7.32|Act.5:13 7:32]], [[Rom.15.18|Rom.15:18]], [[1Co.6.1|1Co.6:1]], [[2Co.10.12|2Co.10:12]], [[Php.1.14|Php.1:14]], [[Jude.9|Ju 9]]; to submit to (in cl. usually absol. in this sense), [[Rom.5.7|Rom.5:7]] (see Field, _Notes_, 155); τολμήσας εἰσῆλθεν, took courage and went in (see Field, _op. cit._, 44), [[Mrk.15.43|Mrk.15:43]] (cf. ἀπο-τολμάω).†
(AS)

G5158.def:
**τρόπος**, -ου, ὁ
(τρέπω), [in LXX chiefly (ὃν τ.) for אֲשֶׁר ;]
1. **a way, manner, fashion**: [[Mat.23.37|Mat.23:37]], [[Luk.13.34|Luk.13:34]], [[Act.1.11; 7.28|Act.1:11 7:28]], [[2Ti.3.8|2Ti.3:8]], [[Jude.7|Ju 7]]; καθ᾽ ὃν τ., [[Act.15.11; 27.25|Act.15:11 27:25]] (ef. MM, xxv); κατὰ πάντα τ., [[Rom.3.2|Rom.3:2]] κατὰ μηδένα τ. ([[4Ma.4.24|4Ma.4:24]], al.), [[2Th.2.3|2Th.2:3]]; (ἐν) παντὶ τ., [[Php.1.18|Php.1:18]], [[2Th.3.16|2Th.3:16]]
2. **Of persons, manner of life, character **(Hdt., Æsch., al.): [[Heb.13.5|Heb.13:5]]†
(AS)

G5176.def:
**τρώγω **
1. prop., of animals, to gnaw, munch, crunch (Hom., al.).
2. Of men, to eat raw food, as vegetables, nuts, etc. (Hdt., al.).
3. **In late vernacular, simply to eat **(= ἐσθίω): [[Mat.24.38|Mat.24:38]], [[Jhn.6.54, 56-58; 13.18|Jhn.6:54, 56-58 13:18]] (LXX ἐσθίων) (see Kennedy, _Sources_, 82, 155; MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5180.def:
**τύπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for hi. ;]
**to strike, smite, beat**: with accusative, [[Mat.24.49|Mat.24:49]], [[Mrk.15.19|Mrk.15:19]], [[Luk.12.45|Luk.12:45]], [[Act.18.17; 21.32; 23.2-3|Act.18:17 21:32 23:2-3]]; of mourners, τὰ στήθη, [[Luk.18.13; 23.48|Luk.18:13 23:48]]; ἐπὶ τ. σιαγόνα, [[Luk.6.29|Luk.6:29]] εἰς τ. κεφαλήν, [[Mat.27.30|Mat.27:30]] Metaphorical, of God inflicting evil: [[Act.23.3|Act.23:3]] (cf. [[Exo.8.2|Exo.8:2]], [[Ezk.7.9|Eze.7:9]], al.); of disquieting conscience, [[1Co.8.12|1Co.8:12]]†
(AS)

G5133.def:
**τραπεζείτης** (Rec. -ζίτης, as in cl.), -ου, ὁ
(τράπεζα),
**a money­changer, banker**: [[Mat.25.27|Mat.25:27]] (Dem., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G5110.def:
**τόκος**, -ου, ὁ
(τίκτω), [in LXX for נֶשֶׁךְ, etc. ;]
(a) **a bringing forth, birth**;
(b) offspring. Metaphorical, of the produce of money lent out, **interest, usury **(cf. Merch. of Venice, I, iii, "a breed of barren metal "): [[Mat.25.27|Mat.25:27]], [[Luk.19.23|Luk.19:23]] (Soph., Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G5165.def:
**τρύβλιον (Rec. τρυβλίον), -ου, τό **
[in LXX chiefly for קְעָרָה ;]
**a bowl, dish**: [[Mat.26.23|Mat.26:23]], [[Mrk.14.20|Mrk.14:20]] (Hippocr., Aristoph., Pint., al.).†
(AS)

G5143.def:
**τρέχω **
[in LXX chiefly for רוּץ ;]
**to run**: [[Mrk.5.6|Mrk.5:6]], [[Jhn.20.2|Jhn.20:2]], 4, [[1Co.9.24; 9.26|1Co.9:24 9:26]]; with inf., [[Mat.28.8|Mat.28:8]] before ἐπί, [[Luk.24.12|Luk.24:12]] [T [WH] R, mg., om.]; εἰς, [[Rev.9.9|Rev.9:9]] ptcp., δραμών, with indic., [[Mat.27.48|Mat.27:48]], [[Mrk.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[Luk.15.20|Luk.15:20]]. Metaphorical, from runners in a race, of swiftness or of effort to attain an end: [[Rom.9.16|Rom.9:16]], [[Gal.2.2; 5.7|Gal.2:2 5:7]], [[Php.2.16|Php.2:16]]; τ. ἀγῶνα (Hdt., Eur., al.), [[Heb.12.1|Heb.12:1]] ὁ λόγος τ. κυρίου (cf. [[Psa.147.4|Psa.147:4]]), ἕως τάχους δραμεῖται ὁ λ. αὐτοῦ), [[2Th.3.1|2Th.3:1]] (cf. εἰς-, κατα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ἐπι-συν-, ὑπο-τρέχω)
δράμω, obsol., to run, see: τρέχω
(AS)

G5122.def:
**τοὔνομα **
by crasis for τὸ ὄνομα, accusative absol.,
**by name**: [[Mat.27.57|Mat.27:57]]†
(AS)

G5141.def:
**τρέμω **
to tremble, esp. with fear: [[Mrk.5.33|Mrk.5:33]], [[Luk.8.47|Luk.8:47]]; with ptcp. (in cl more frequently with inf.), [[2Pe.2.10|2Pe.2:10]]†
(AS)

G5149.def:
**τρίζω **
[in Aq.: [[Amo.2.13|Amo.2:13]] Sm.: [[Isa.38.14|Isa.38:14]] * ;]
1. prop., of sounds by animals, to cry, chirp, etc.
2. Of other sounds, e.g., trans., τ. ὀδόντας, **to gnash or grind the teeth**: [[Mrk.9.18|Mrk.9:18]]†
(AS)

G5168.def:
**τρυμαλιά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(τρύω, to wear away), [in LXX: [[Jer.13.4|Jer.13:4]] (נָקִיק), etc. ;]
**= τρύμη, a hole**: τ. ῥαφίδος, eye of a needle, [[Mrk.10.25|Mrk.10:25]]†
_SYN._: τρῆμα, τρύπημα (AS)

G5156.def:
**τρόμος**, -ου, ὁ
(τρέμω), [in LXX for רַעַד, רַעַד, פַּחַד, etc. ;]
trembling, quaking, esp. from fear: [[Mrk.16.8|Mrk.16:8]] φόβος κ. τ. (as in [[Gen.9.2|Gen.9:2]], [[Exo.15.16|Exo.15:16]], [[Deu.2.25|Deu.2:25]], [[Isa.19.16|Isa.19:16]], al.), [[1Co.2.3|1Co.2:3]], [[2Co.7.15|2Co.7:15]], [[Eph.6.5|Eph.6:5]], [[Php.2.12|Php.2:12]].†
(AS)

G5167.def:
**τρυγών**, -όνος, ἡ
(τρύζω, to murmur, coo), [in LXX for תּוֹר ;]
**a turtle-dove**: [[Luk.2.24|Luk.2:24]]†
(AS)

G5139.def:
**Τραχωνῖτις**, -ιδος, ἡ
(τραχύς)
Trachonitis, a rough region S. of Damascus (in FlJ, sometimes ἡ Τ., sometimes ό Τράχων): ἡ Τ. χώρα, [[Luk.3.1|Luk.3:1]]†
(AS)

G5138.def:
**τραχύς**, -εῖα, -ύ
[in LXX: [[Isa.40.4|Isa.40:4]] (רֶכֶס), etc. ;]
**rough**: ὁδοί (Is, l.with), [[Luk.3.5|Luk.3:5]] (LXX); τοποί (i.e. rocky), [[Act.27.29|Act.27:29]]†
(AS)

G5198.def:
**ὑγιαίνω**
(ὑγιής), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלוֹם, and frequently in To ;]
**to be sound, healthy, in good health**: [[Luk.5.31; 7.10; 15.27|Luk.5:31 7:10 15:27]], [[3Jn.2|3Jo.2]]. In Past. Epp. (as also in cl.) metaphorically, ὑ. ἐν τ. πίστει, [[Tit.1.13|Tit.1:13]] ; τ. πίστει, τ. ἀγάπῃ, τ. ὑπομονῇ, [[Tit.2.2|Tit.2:2]] ἡ ὑγιαίνουσα διδασκαλία, [[1Ti.1.10|1Ti.1:10]], [[2Ti.4.3|2Ti.4:3]], [[Tit.1.9; 2.1|Tit.1:9 2:1]] ; λόγοι ὑγιαίνοντες, [[1Ti.6.3|1Ti.6:3]], [[2Ti.1.13|2Ti.1:13]].†
(AS)

G5166.def:
**τρυγάω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for קָצַר, בָּצַר, etc. ;]
**to gather in**: with accusative,
(a) of the fruit, [[Luk.6.44|Luk.6:44]], [[Rev.14.18|Rev.14:18]];
(b) of that from which it is gathered, [[Rev.14.19|Rev.14:19]]†
(AS)

G5172.def:
**τρυφή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for עָדַן ;]
**softness, daintiness, luxuriousness**: [[Luk.7.25|Luk.7:25]], [[2Pe.2.13|2Pe.2:13]].†
(AS)

G5134.def:
**τραῦμα**, -τος, τό
[in LXX for פָּצַע, חָלַל, etc. ;]
**a wowed**: [[Luk.10.34|Luk.10:34]]†
(AS)

G5106.def:
**τοί-νυν **
_an inferential particle_, [in LXX: [[Isa.3.10; 5.13; 27.4|Isa.3:10 5:13 27:4]], [[Wis.1.11; 8.9|Wis.1:11 8:9]], a1. * ;]
**accordingly, therefore**: as in cl., after the first word in a sentence, [[1Co.9.26|1Co.9:26]] accusative to later usage, at the beginning, [[Luk.20.25|Luk.20:25]], [[Heb.13.13|Heb.13:13]].†
(AS)

G5177.def:
**τυγχάνω **
[in LXX: [[Deu.19.5|Deu.19:5]] (מָצָא), [[Job.3.21; 7.2; 17.1|Job.3:21 7:2 17:1]], [[Pro.30.23|Pro.30:23]] (without definite _Heb._ equiv.), [[Wis.15.19|Wis.15:19]], [[1Ma.11.42|1Ma.11:42]], [[3Ma.3.7|3Ma.3:7]], al. ;]
I. Trans.
1. to hit (opposite to ἁμαρτάνω, **to miss the mark**: Hom., Xen., al.).
2. **to hit upon, light upon**;
(a) **of persons, to meet with, fall in with**: absol., ptcp., ὁ τυχών, a chance person, anyone (Lat. quivis), οὐ τυχών, not common or ordinary, [[Act.19.11; 28.2|Act.19:11 28:2]];
(b) **of things, to reach, get, obtain**: with genitive of thing(s) [[Luk.20.35|Luk.20:35]], [[Act.24.3; 26.22; 27.3|Act.24:3 26:22 27:3]], [[2Ti.2.10|2Ti.2:10]] [[Heb.8.6; 11.35|Heb.8:6 11:35]].
II. Intrans., to happen; of things, **to happen, chance, befall**: impers., εἰ τύχοι, it may be, perhaps, [[1Co.14.10; 15.37|1Co.14:10 15:37]]; so ptcp., τυχόν (old accusative absol.; see M, _Pr._, 74), [[1Co.16.6|1Co.16:6]]
(cf. ἐν-, ὑπερ-εν-, ἐπι-, παρα-, συν-τυγχάνω).†
τυχόν, adv., see: τυγχάνω
(AS)

G5186.def:
**τυφλόω**, -ῶ
(τυφλός), [in LXX: [[Isa.42.19|Isa.42:19]] (עִוֵּר), [[Tob.7.7|Tob.7:7]] א, [[Wis.2.21|Wis.2:21]] א * ;]
**to blind, make blind**: metaphorically, [[Jhn.12.40|Jhn.12:40]] (LXX, καμμύω), [[2Co.4.4|2Co.4:4]], [[1Jn.2.11|1Jn.2:11]].†
(AS)

G5102.def:
**τίτλος**, -ου, ὁ
(Lat. titulus), [in Aq., Sm., _Th._: [[Jer.21.4|Jer.21:4]] * ;]
**a title, inscription**: [[Jhn.19.19-20|Jhn.19:19-20]] (in Christian Inscr., epitaph, see MM. xxiv).†
(AS)

G5179.def:
**τύπος**, -ου, ὁ
(τύπτω), [in LXX: [[Exo.25.39|Exo.25:39]] (40) (תַּבְנִית), [[Amo.5.26|Amo.5:26]], [[3Ma.3.30|3Ma.3:30]], [[4Ma.6.19|4Ma.6:19]] * ;]
1. **the mark of a blow**: τῶν ἥλων, [[Jhn.20.25|Jhn.20:25]]
2. **An impression, impress, the stamp made by a die; hence, a figure, image**: [[Act.7.43|Act.7:43]] (LXX).
3. **form **(Plat.): [[Rom.6.17|Rom.6:17]] the sense or substance of a letter (3Mac, l.with), [[Act.23.25|Act.23:25]]
4. **an example, pattern**: [[Act.7.44|Act.7:44]], [[Heb.8.6|Heb.8:6]]" (LXX) ; in ethical sense, [[Php.3.17|Php.3:17]], [[1Th.1.7|1Th.1:7]], [[2Th.3.9|2Th.3:9]], [[1Ti.4.12|1Ti.4:12]], [[Tit.2.7|Tit.2:7]], [[1Pe.5.3|1Pe.5:3]]; in doctrinal sense, type (see _ICC_, in l), [[Rom.5.14|Rom.5:14]]†
τυπικῶς, adv.
(τύπος),
(a) typically (Greg. Naz.)
(b) **by way of example**: [[1Co.10.11|1Co.10:11]]†
_SYN._: see: ὑποτύπωσις (AS)

G5159.def:
**τροπο-φορέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Deu.1.31|Deu.1:31]] B.l (נָשָׂא) * ;]
1. **to bear another's manners **(R, txt., suffered he their manners): with accusative of person(s), [[Act.13.18|Act.13:18]] (Rec., WH, R, txt.; ἐτροφο-, T, R, mg.).
2. = τροφοφορέω (which see), (see Kühner3, I, 276): Ac, l.with†
(AS)

G5181.def:
1. **an absolute sovereign **, unlimited by law or constitution, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: not applied to old hereditary sovereignties βασιλεῖαι); such as those of (Homer) or of Sparta; for the term rather regards the irregular way in which the power was **gained **, than the way in which it was **exercised **, being applied to the mild Pisistratus, but not to the despotic kings of Persia. However, the word soon came to imply reproach, like our **tyrant **, (Plato Philosophus), etc.
2. in a wider sense, **the tyrant's son **, or **any member of his family **, (Sophocles Tragicus):—;so, ἡ τύραννος was both **the queen ** herself or **a princess **, (Euripides)
3. τύραννος, ον, as _adjective_ **kingly, royal **, [_variant_ datesTragica Adespota
4. **imperious, despotic **, (Thucydides); τύραννα δρᾶν (Sophocles Tragicus)
τύραννος is probably from same Root as κύριος, κοίρανος. (ML)

G5152.def:
**τρίστεγος**, -ον (τρεῖς, στέγη)
[in Sm.: [[Gen.6.17|Gen.6:17]](16), [[Ezk.42.6|Eze.42:6]] * ;]
**of three stories**: τὸ τ. (sc. ὄκημα),
the third story, [[Act.20.9|Act.20:9]] (Dion., FlJ, al.).†
(AS)

G5148.def:
**τριετία**, -ας, ἡ
(τρεῖς, ἔτος),
**a period of three years**: [[Act.20.31|Act.20:31]]†
(AS)

G5109.def:
**τοῖχος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for קִיר ;]
a wall, esp. of a house: figuratively, [[Act.23.3|Act.23:3]] (cf. τεῖχος).†
(AS)

G5196.def:
**ὕβρις**, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
1. wantonness, insolence.
2. **= ὕβρισμα, an act of wanton violence, an outrage, injury**: [[2Co.12.10|2Co.12:10]] metaphorically, of a loss by sea (find.), [[Act.27.10, 21|Act.27:10, 21]] (see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5197.def:
**ὑβριστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὑβρίζω), [in LXX chiefly for גֵּאֶה ;]
**a violent, insolent man**: [[Rom.1.20|Rom.1:20]], [[1Ti.1.13|1Ti.1:13]] (EV, injurious).†
_SYN._: ἀλαζών, ὑπερήφανος, see Tr., _Syn._, § xxix (AS)

G5170.def:
**Τρύφαινα**, -ης, ἡ
**Tryphæna**: [[Rom.16.12|Rom.16:12]] (see Lft., Phi., 175 f.; MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5173.def:
**Τρυφῶσα**, -ης, ἡ, ς, ἡ
**Tryphosa**: [[Rom.16.12|Rom.16:12]] (see Lft., Phi., 175 f.).†
(AS)

G5121.def:
**τοὐναντίον **
by crasis for τὸ ἐνανίον, neut. accusative, used adverbially, **on the contrary, contrariwise**: [[2Co.2.7|2Co.2:7]], [[Gal.2.7|Gal.2:7]], [[1Pe.3.9|1Pe.3:9]].†
(AS)

G5105.def:
**τοι-γαρ-οῦν **
_an inferential particle_, [in LXX: [[Job.22.10; 24.22|Job.22:10 24:22]], [[Sir.41.16|Sir.41:16]], al. ;]
**wherefore then, so therefore**: [[1Th.4.8|1Th.4:8]], [[Heb.12.1|Heb.12:1]] (Hat., Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G5187.def:
**τυφόω**, -ῶ
(τῦφος, smoke; metaphorically, conceit),
prop., to wrap in smoke; used only metaphorically, **to puff up, becloud with pride**: pass., [[1Ti.3.6; 6.4|1Ti.3:6 6:4]], [[2Ti.3.4|2Ti.3:4]] (Dem., Arist., al.).†
(AS)

G5136.def:
**τραχηλίζω**
(τράχηλος),
prop., of wrestlers,
to take by the throat, hence (Philo), to prostrate, overthrow. Metaphorical, but in what sense and from what age it is doubtful (see Westc., Rendall, on He, l.with; _DB_, iii, 625n), τραχηλισμένα, **laid open **(RV, Westc.; downcast, Rendall): [[Heb.4.13|Heb.4:13]]†
(AS)

G5131.def:
**τράγος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עַתּוּד, also for צָפִיר, תַּיִשׁ ;]
**a he-goat**: [[Heb.9.12-13, 19; 10.4|Heb.9:12-13, 19 10:4]].†
(AS)

G5150.def:
**τρίμηνος**, -ον
(τρεῖς, μήν) [in LXX (neut.): [[Gen.38.24|Gen.38:24]], [[2Ki.23.31|4Ki.23:31]] B [[4Ki.24.8|4Ki.24:8]], [[2Ch.36.2; 36.9|2Ch.36:2 36:9]] (חֹדֶשׁ שָׁלוֹשׁ) * ;]
**of three months**; as subst., τὸ τ. (= cl. ἡ τ.), a space of three months (Polyb., al.; LXX): [[Heb.11.23|Heb.11:23]]†
(AS)

G5178.def:
**τυμπανίζω**
(τύμπανον, a kettle-drum), [in LXX: [[1Sa.21.13|1Ki.21:13]] (14) (17 pi?) * ;]
1. to beat a drum.
2. **to torture by beating, beat to death **(cf. Westc. on He, l.with): pass., [[Heb.11.35|Heb.11:35]]†
(AS)

G5163.def:
**τροχιά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(τροχός), [in LXX: [[Pro.2.15; 4.11, 26-27; 5.6, 21|Pro.2:15 4:11, 26-27 5:6, 21]] (מַעְגָּל), [[Ezk.27.19|Eze.27:19]] A* ;]
**the track of a wheel, hence, a track, path**: figuratively, [[Heb.12.13|Heb.12:13]] (LXX) †
(AS)

G5157.def:
**τροπή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(τρέπω), [in LXX: [[Deu.33.14|Deu.33:14]], [[Job.38.33|Job.38:33]], [[Wis.7.18|Wis.7:18]], al. ;]
**a turning**: esp. of the revolution of heavenly bodies, figuratively, [[Jas.1.17|Jas.1:17]] (see: ἀποσκίασμα).†
(AS)

G5164.def:
**τροχός**, -οῦ, τό
(τρέχω), [in LXX chiefly for אוֹפָן ;]
**a wheel**: [[Jas.3.6|Jas.3:6]] (see Mayor, Hort, in l).†
(AS)

G5171.def:
**τρυφάω**, -ῶ
(τρυφή), [in LXX: [[Neh.9.25|Neh.9:25]] (עָדַן hithp.), [[Isa.66.11|Isa.66:11]] (עָנַג hithp.), [[Sir.14.4|Sir.14:4]] * ;]
**to live daintily, luxuriously, to fare sumptuously**: [[Jas.5.5|Jas.5:5]] (cf. ἐν-τρυφάω).†
_SYN._: σπαταλάω (which see), στρηνιάω (AS)

G5107.def: _antecedent_ to οἷος, as ἀοιδοῦ τοιοῦδ᾽ οἷος ὅδ᾽ ἐστί of **such a ** minstrel as is this one, (Odyssey by Homer); _absolute_, ἀλλ᾽ ὅδ᾽ ἐγὼ τοιόσδε here am I **such as you see **, (Odyssey by Homer):—;also, **so great, so noble, so bad **, τοιάδε λαίφη **such ** clothes, i. e. **so bad **, (Odyssey by Homer); τοσόσδε καὶ τοιόσδε (Herdotus Historicus):—;also with a qualifying word, τοιόσδ᾽ ἠμὲν δέμας ἠδὲ καὶ ἔργα **such ** both in form and works, (Odyssey by Homer):—;with the Art., ὁ τ. ἀνήρ (Aeschulus Tragicus), etc.; οἱ τοιοίδε (Sophocles Tragicus); ἐν τῷ τοιῷδε in **such ** circumstances, (Herdotus Historicus):—;the sense is made more indefinite in τοιόσδε τις **such a ** one, (Thucydides):—;_neuter_ _plural_ τοιάδε **as follows **, τοιαῦτα **as aforesaid **, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G5115.def:
**τόξον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for קֶשֶׁת ;]
**a bow**: [[Rev.6.2|Rev.6:2]]†
(AS)

G5191.def:
**ὑακίνθινος**, -η, -ον
(ὑάκινθος), [in LXX for תַּחַשׁ, תְּכֵלֶת ;]
of hyacinth, hyacinthine (see: ὑάκινθος), "doubtless meant to describe the blue smoke of a sulphurous flame" (Swete): [[Rev.9.17|Rev.9:17]] (Hom., Eur., al.).†
(AS)

G5194.def:
**ὕαλος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Job.28.17|Job.28:17]] (זְכוּכִית) * ;]
1. (Hdt.) a clear transparent stone.
2. (from Plat. on) glass: [[Rev.21.18, 21|Rev.21:18, 21]].†
(AS)
